items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: And he listed, did he say Jay Leonhart and Jack Lesberg and Ron Carter and Rufus Reid are going to be the other bass players.

ctx.x: Which I heard you do the other night.
Yeah. And he listed, did he say Jay Leonhart and Jack Lesberg and Ron Carter and Rufus Reid are going to be the other bass players. So that’s going to be a great honor.
